BL 2 → Spine 1 has a four-cell text interruption: ECMP at [20,23,4,1] replaces its apparent horizontal stroke between crowded crossings. Blind Stage A retained the endpoint match as a candidate, not a fully verified path. JSON intent cannot upgrade the frozen visual result.

Seven V4 links have traceable endpoints but unresolved edge-label ownership: ECMP/dual strings sit between or near multiple routes without a unique attachment. Identical words preserve a rough tier meaning, not the required independently readable per-relationship label meaning. Counting eight ECMP and four dual labels is not an association audit.

All nodes and labels fit in 77×47, but text overlays route cells in V4 at [16,21,1,1] and [20,23,4,1]. Thus the no-overlay-occlusion clause fails despite compact extents, no clipping, and clean checks.
